title: Mitigating Text Toxicity with Counterfactual Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the reduction of biased and offensive language using a pre-trained toxicity classifier (toxic-bert) and human annotator rankings on datasets specifically containing socially-biased interactions, such as Social Bias Frames (SBF) and Microaggressions (MAgr).

Measuring detoxification accuracy and overall toxicity scores of text rewritten via counterfactual generation on the DynaHate dataset, evaluated both automatically and through a human-grounded protocol.
